value.original: This process registers a module in the central repository checking the name, java package, db_prefix etc. are available to be used. To register a module you must have a valid username and password in Openbravo Central Repository. You should register into Openbravo Forge to obtain these credentials

value.original: This action updates the log level of the given loggers, overwriting their default configuration. Note that this changes will be reverted if Tomcat is restarted so consider editing the log4j config files if changes are meant to be permanent.
